
(function(){

  var SVGNS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";

  /* Countdown length is configurable; burn time is fixed at 1/5 of it
     (matching the original 15:00 / 03:00 design). */
  var DUR = 30;
  function burnOf(x){ return x * 0.2; }
  function endOf(x){ return x * 1.2; }
  function mmss(sec){
    sec = Math.round(sec);
    return String(Math.floor(sec / 60)).padStart(2, "0") + ":" + String(sec % 60).padStart(2, "0");
  }

  var CY = 250.5, SLOT_X = [116, 180, 227, 274, 338];
  var PCX = 227, PCY = 248.5;                  /* pan centre */
  var FORK_IMG = "data:image/png;base64,";
  var KNIFE_IMG = "data:image/png;base64,";
  var FORK_D = "M12.3564 2.56583C13.6058 2.64554 14.6986 2.85011 15.6504 3.1381V22.9467H18.2851V4.30411C20.5977 5.71409 21.4157 7.45191 21.4228 7.4672C21.4228 7.4672 22.8255 24.4746 20.4345 31.5102C18.0436 38.5457 14.5068 43.6967 14.5068 43.6967L16.8125 132.293C16.8079 132.317 15.8127 137.563 10.8838 137.563C5.96281 137.563 4.30977 132.334 4.29685 132.293L8.5781 43.6967C8.5781 43.6967 4.61329 38.5703 1.99118 31.5102C-0.630925 24.45 1.0029 7.4672 1.0029 7.4672C1.0029 7.4672 1.736 5.896 3.79294 4.52579V22.9467H6.42771V3.25138C7.37266 2.9349 8.46438 2.69581 9.72165 2.58927V22.9467H12.3564V2.56583Z", FORK_VB = "0 0 25.3317 138.063";
  var KNIFE_D = "M8.23242 0.652326C9.18142 0.274108 9.92016 0.674693 10.3672 1.10838C10.5868 1.32143 10.7489 1.55083 10.8545 1.72264C10.9077 1.80933 10.9486 1.88392 10.9766 1.93846C10.9905 1.96561 11.5645 74.1504C11.637 75.6731 11.7391 77.8545 11.8574 80.4883C12.094 85.7556 12.3956 92.8342 12.6553 100.078C12.9149 107.321 13.132 114.734 13.2012 120.666C13.2357 123.632 13.234 126.232 13.1807 132.508C3.05526 132.174 2.99212 131.667 2.94922 131.047C2.90546 130.415 2.88031 129.625 2.87207 128.706C2.85559 126.867 2.90418 124.485 2.99512 121.75C3.17703 116.28 3.53173 109.377 3.89356 102.544C4.25553 95.708 4.62392 88.9421 4.83398 83.7373C4.93904 81.1345 5.0048 78.9278 5.00977 77.3008C5.01225 76.4866 4.99911 75.8248 4.96973 75.334C4.95502 75.0883 4.93649 74.8927 4.91504 68.6299C0.858505 68.4758 0.809247 68.2791 0.771485 68.0732C0.732161 67.8588 0.698841 67.5999 0.669922 67.3037C0.612037 66.7107 0.570593 65.9415 0.542969 65.0263C0.487679 63.1945 0.488224 60.7495 0.532227 57.8984C0.620258 52.1947 0.883523 44.8449 1.23535 37.4805C1.5872 30.1156 2.0277 22.7306 2.46777 16.958C2.68776 14.0724 2.90745 11.5856 3.11719 9.70408C3.222 8.76389 3.32549 7.9704 3.42481 7.35154C3.52165 6.74813 3.6211 6.26781 3.73047 5.98436C4.44813 4.12447 5.18118 2.93744 5.94531 2.13768C6.71751 1.32948 7.49433 0.946511 8.23242 0.652326Z", KNIFE_VB = "0 0 13.7245 137.002";

  /* The Figma source gives each utensil a highlight clipped to its outline;
     an earlier simplification dropped it. */
  var SHINE = {
    fork:  [[5.258, 38.566, 37.125, 13.014, 42.2985]],
    knife: [[-1.5, 28, 30, 7.4, 52.3], [0.6, 50, 25, 4.6, 52.3]]
  };
  var cutN = 0;

  /* One knife or fork: translate to the target centre, rotate, scale,
     then bring the shape's own centre back to the origin. */
  function cutleryAt(parent, cx, cy, d, vb, deg, h, kind){
    var wh = vb.split(" "), vw = parseFloat(wh[2]), vh = parseFloat(wh[3]);
    var sc = h / vh;
    var g = el("g", {transform:"translate(" + cx + "," + cy + ") rotate(" + deg + ") " +
                               "scale(" + sc + ") translate(" + (-vw / 2) + "," + (-vh / 2) + ")",
                     filter:"url(#fx-cutlery)"});
    g.appendChild(el("path", {d:d, fill:"#DED6D6", stroke:"#A39191", "stroke-width":1.6 / sc}));
    if (kind && SHINE[kind]){
      /* highlight clipped inside the utensil outline */
      var cid = "cutclip" + (++cutN);
      var cp = el("clipPath", {id:cid});
      cp.appendChild(el("path", {d:d}));
      g.appendChild(cp);
      var sg = el("g", {"clip-path":"url(#" + cid + ")", fill:"#FAF3F3", opacity:0.9});
      SHINE[kind].forEach(function(r){
        sg.appendChild(el("rect", {x:r[0], y:r[1], width:r[2], height:r[3],
                                   transform:"rotate(" + r[4] + " " + r[0] + " " + r[1] + ")"}));
      });
      g.appendChild(sg);
    }
    parent.appendChild(g);
    return g;
  }


  /* Dial: the handle at bottom-dead-centre is the shortest time; turning
     clockwise adds more. A 50-degree gap keeps the minimum and maximum
     from landing on the same spot. */
  var DIAL_MIN = 30, DIAL_MAX = 900, DIAL_STEP = 30, DIAL_SWEEP = 310;
  var DIAL_STEPS = (DIAL_MAX - DIAL_MIN) / DIAL_STEP;
  function durToAngle(d){
    return (Math.max(DIAL_MIN, Math.min(DIAL_MAX, d)) - DIAL_MIN) / (DIAL_MAX - DIAL_MIN) * DIAL_SWEEP;
  }
  function angleToDur(a){
    var i = Math.round(a / DIAL_SWEEP * DIAL_STEPS);
    return DIAL_MIN + Math.max(0, Math.min(DIAL_STEPS, i)) * DIAL_STEP;
  }
  /* Then pull each glyph towards a 58px target, clamped to 0.92x-1.15x.
     Only "1" is unusually narrow in Chango (42.3); forcing it to 58 turns
     it into an unrecognisable brick. Every other digit already sits between
     53.8 and 63.3, so after clamping they all land exactly on 58. */
  var TARGET_W = 58, MEASURE = null, ADV = {};
  function advance(ch){
    if (ADV[ch] != null) return ADV[ch];
    if (!MEASURE){
      var host = document.createElementNS(SVGNS, "svg");
      host.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      host.setAttribute("style", "position:absolute;width:0;height:0;overflow:hidden");
      MEASURE = document.createElementNS(SVGNS, "text");
      MEASURE.setAttribute("class", "cake");
      host.appendChild(MEASURE);
      document.body.appendChild(host);
    }
    MEASURE.textContent = ch;
    ADV[ch] = MEASURE.getComputedTextLength();
    return ADV[ch];
  }
  function slotLen(ch, i){
    if (i === 2) return null;                       /* the colon keeps its natural width */
    var n = advance(ch);
    if (!n) return null;
    return Math.max(n * 0.92, Math.min(n * 1.15, TARGET_W));
  }

  /* ---- Bubble seeds: positions measured off the dots in Figma
         (454x500 frame coordinates) ---- */
  var FIG_BUB  = [[124,270,2,2],[118,273,3,4],[335,236,5,5],[342,241,2,2],
                  [179,229,2,2],[183,230,5,4],[242,272,2,2],[246,273,5,4]];
  var FIG_CHAR = [[338,233,8,7],[347,241,5,5],[245,262,8,7],[185,229,13,8],
                  [171,274,3,3],[162,269,7,5],[253,269,5,5],[99,238,11,7]];

  function rnd(i, salt){
    var x = Math.sin(i * 127.1 + salt * 311.7) * 43758.5453;
    return x - Math.floor(x);
  }

  var BUBBLES = [];
  FIG_BUB.forEach(function(p, i){
    BUBBLES.push({
      x:p[0]+p[2]/2, y:p[1]+p[3]/2, r:Math.max(p[2],p[3])/2 + 1.0,
      born:0.055 + 0.05 * rnd(i,1), charAt:9, ph:rnd(i,2) * 6.283
    });
  });
  FIG_CHAR.forEach(function(p, i){
    BUBBLES.push({
      x:p[0]+p[2]/2, y:p[1]+p[3]/2, r:Math.max(p[2],p[3])/2 * 0.5 + 1.1,
      born:0.09 + 0.28 * rnd(i,3), charAt:0.02 + 0.40 * rnd(i,4), ph:rnd(i,5) * 6.283
    });
  });
  for (var bi = 0; bi < 16; bi++){
    BUBBLES.push({
      x:96 + rnd(bi,6) * 262,
      y:222 + rnd(bi,7) * 57,
      r:1.3 + rnd(bi,8) * 2.2,
      born:0.06 + 0.34 * rnd(bi,9),
      charAt:rnd(bi,10) < 0.4 ? 0.04 + 0.46 * rnd(bi,11) : 9,
      ph:rnd(bi,12) * 6.283
    });
  }

  function el(name, attrs){
    var n = document.createElementNS(SVGNS, name);
    for (var k in attrs) n.setAttribute(k, attrs[k]);
    return n;
  }

  /* ---- One pan ---- */
  function makeTiimer(opts){
    opts = opts || {};
    var uid = "g" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8);
    var svg = el("svg", {viewBox:opts.frame || "0 0 454 500", width:"100%", role:"img"});
    svg.setAttribute("aria-label", opts.label || "Pancake timer");

    var defs = el("defs");
    var lg = el("linearGradient", {id:uid, x1:81.8621, y1:75.25, x2:298.534, y2:266.491,
                                   gradientUnits:"userSpaceOnUse"});
    lg.appendChild(el("stop", {"stop-color":"#474B50"}));
    lg.appendChild(el("stop", {offset:"1", "stop-color":"#AFAFAF"}));
    defs.appendChild(lg);
    svg.appendChild(defs);

    svg.appendChild(el("rect", {x:-140, y:-140, width:740, height:800, fill:"#f5e6e6"}));

    var dialG = null;
    if (opts.dial){
      var dial = dialG = el("g", {"class":"dial"});
      for (var di = 0; di <= DIAL_STEPS; di++){
        var major = (DIAL_MIN + di * DIAL_STEP) % 300 === 0 || di === 0 || di === DIAL_STEPS;
        var a = di / DIAL_STEPS * DIAL_SWEEP;
        dial.appendChild(el("line", {
          x1:PCX, y1:PCY + 184, x2:PCX, y2:PCY + (major ? 200 : 193),
          stroke:major ? "#b9a595" : "#cfc0b3",
          "stroke-width":major ? 4 : 2,
          "stroke-linecap":"round",
          transform:"rotate(" + a + " " + PCX + " " + PCY + ")"
        }));
      }
      svg.appendChild(dial);
    }

    /* Pan and handle rotate as one group. The pan face is a perfect circle,
       so all the viewer sees is the handle moving. */
    var panExit = el("g");          /* the whole pan exits downwards on serve */
    var rotG = el("g");
    panExit.appendChild(rotG);
    svg.appendChild(panExit);

    /* handle — sits beneath the pan */
    var hand = el("g", {transform:"translate(189,396)"});
    hand.appendChild(el("rect", {x:11, y:33, width:54, height:48, fill:"#AEB0B2"}));
    hand.appendChild(el("rect", {x:0, y:61, width:75, height:195, rx:20, fill:"#363B3F"}));
    hand.appendChild(el("path", {d:"M65 42.0947C56.1805 43.3494 47.1662 44 38 44C28.8338 44 19.8195 43.3494 11 42.0947V0H65V42.0947Z", fill:"#83868B"}));
    rotG.appendChild(hand);

    var pan = el("g", {transform:"translate(49,70.5)"});   /* measured off the PNG: outer rim top at y=72 */
    pan.appendChild(el("circle", {cx:178, cy:178, r:176.5, fill:"#585E64", stroke:"#C0C7CD", "stroke-width":3}));
    pan.appendChild(el("circle", {cx:178, cy:178, r:162, fill:"#33373C", stroke:"#24272B", "stroke-width":2}));
    pan.appendChild(el("circle", {cx:178.5, cy:178.5, r:145, fill:"#585E64", stroke:"url(#"+uid+")", "stroke-width":5}));
    rotG.appendChild(pan);

    if (opts.dial){
      /* The whole handle is grabbable: this covers its full length from the
         pan rim to the tip, with 20px of slop on each side. */
      var grip = el("rect", {x:169, y:396, width:115, height:262, rx:40,
                             fill:"transparent", "class":"grip"});
      grip.setAttribute("tabindex", "0");
      grip.setAttribute("role", "slider");
      grip.setAttribute("aria-label", "Turn the handle to set the countdown");
      grip.setAttribute("aria-valuemin", DIAL_MIN);
      grip.setAttribute("aria-valuemax", DIAL_MAX);
      rotG.appendChild(grip);
      svg.grip = grip;
    }

    /* Plate: Figma node 2696:2130, 362x362, sharing the pan's centre */
    var plateG = null;
    if (opts.dial){
      plateG = el("g", {opacity:0});
      var pin = el("g", {transform:"translate(46,67.5)"});
      var rim = el("g", {filter:"url(#fx-plate)"});
      rim.appendChild(el("circle", {cx:181, cy:181, r:175, fill:"#F7E8E5"}));
      rim.appendChild(el("circle", {cx:181, cy:181, r:177.5, fill:"none", stroke:"#D4CEC7", "stroke-width":5}));
      pin.appendChild(rim);
      pin.appendChild(el("ellipse", {cx:180.5, cy:175, rx:171.5, ry:169, fill:"#FFFBFB"}));
      pin.appendChild(el("ellipse", {cx:180.5, cy:181, rx:171.5, ry:163, fill:"#F8EFE7"}));
      var well = el("g", {filter:"url(#fx-plate)"});
      well.appendChild(el("circle", {cx:181, cy:182, r:115, fill:"#F8EFE7"}));
      well.appendChild(el("circle", {cx:181, cy:182, r:112.5, fill:"none", stroke:"#D4CEC7", "stroke-width":5}));
      pin.appendChild(well);
      pin.appendChild(el("ellipse", {cx:261.36, cy:60.2648, rx:20.5, ry:9, fill:"#FFFAF5",
                                     transform:"rotate(41.1393 261.36 60.2648)"}));
      pin.appendChild(el("ellipse", {cx:287.749, cy:83.9491, rx:9, ry:6.5, fill:"#FFFAF5",
                                     transform:"rotate(41.1393 287.749 83.9491)"}));
      plateG.appendChild(pin);
      svg.appendChild(plateG);
    }

    /* Serve cutlery: Figma node 2697:2758 — angled in from the bottom
       corners and clipped by the card. These are raster assets with the
       shading baked in, highlights and grain included. */
    var setG = null, setFork = null, setKnife = null;
    if (opts.dial){
      setG = el("g", {opacity:0});
      setFork = el("image", {x:27.3, y:353, width:90, height:265.2,
                             transform:"rotate(-10 72.3 485.6)", href:FORK_IMG});
      setKnife = el("image", {x:337, y:310, width:80, height:295.1,
                              transform:"rotate(10 377 457.55)", href:KNIFE_IMG});
      setG.appendChild(setFork);
      setG.appendChild(setKnife);
      svg.appendChild(setG);
    }

    /* Batter and bubbles share a group so they move to the plate together */
    var cakeWrap = el("g");
    var cakeG = el("g");
    function slotRow(cls, parent){
      return SLOT_X.map(function(x){
        var n = el("text", {x:x, y:CY, "class":"cake " + cls, lengthAdjust:"spacingAndGlyphs"});
        (parent || cakeG).appendChild(n);
        return n;
      });
    }
    /* Back to front: shadow -> outer edge -> inner edge, so adjacent glyphs
       do not paint over each other. The five shadow glyphs are composited
       opaque inside their own group first, and the 50% is applied to the
       group — otherwise the overlaps would double up and go darker. */
    var shadeG = el("g", {"class":"cake-shade-wrap"});
    cakeG.appendChild(shadeG);
    var shadeSlots = slotRow("cake-outer cake-shade", shadeG);
    var outerSlots = slotRow("cake-outer");
    var innerSlots = slotRow("cake-inner");
    cakeWrap.appendChild(cakeG);

    /* Bubbles belong to the batter, so the same text clips them into the glyphs */
    var clipId = uid + "-cake";
    var clip = el("clipPath", {id:clipId});
    var clipSlots = SLOT_X.map(function(x, i){
      var n = el("text", {x:x, y:CY, "class":"cake", lengthAdjust:"spacingAndGlyphs"});
      clip.appendChild(n);
      return n;
    });
    defs.appendChild(clip);

    var bubbleG = el("g", {"clip-path":"url(#" + clipId + ")"});
    var bubbleNodes = BUBBLES.map(function(){
      var e = el("ellipse", {opacity:0});
      bubbleG.appendChild(e);
      return e;
    });
    cakeWrap.appendChild(bubbleG);
    svg.appendChild(cakeWrap);

    return {
      node: svg,
      set: function(state, dialAngle, plateP){
        rotG.setAttribute("transform",
          "rotate(" + (dialAngle || 0).toFixed(2) + " " + PCX + " " + PCY + ")");

        if (plateG){
          var raw = plateP || 0;
          var pp = clamp(raw);          /* pan, plate and pancake all settle within 0 -> 1 */
          /* the pan slides out, the plate scales in from 0.9, the batter
             hops once and settles */
          panExit.setAttribute("opacity", (1 - smooth((pp - 0.22) / 0.4)).toFixed(3));
          panExit.setAttribute("transform", "translate(0," + (150 * smooth(pp)).toFixed(1) + ")");
          var pk = 0.88 + 0.12 * smooth((pp - 0.18) / 0.5);
          plateG.setAttribute("opacity", smooth((pp - 0.18) / 0.34).toFixed(3));
          plateG.setAttribute("transform",
            "translate(" + PCX + "," + PCY + ") scale(" + pk.toFixed(4) +
            ") translate(" + (-PCX) + "," + (-PCY) + ")");
          var lift = -34 * Math.sin(Math.PI * pp);
          var sq = Math.sin(Math.PI * smooth((pp - 0.72) / 0.28));
          cakeWrap.setAttribute("transform",
            "translate(" + PCX + "," + (PCY + lift).toFixed(2) + ") scale(" +
            (1 + 0.05 * sq).toFixed(4) + "," + (1 - 0.05 * sq).toFixed(4) + ") translate(" +
            (-PCX) + "," + (-PCY) + ")");

          /* the cutlery only pushes up from below once the plate segment is
             completely finished (raw = 1) */
          var ck = smooth((raw - 1) / 0.32);
          var rise = 54 * (1 - ck);
          setG.setAttribute("opacity", ck.toFixed(3));
          setFork.setAttribute("transform",
            "translate(0," + rise.toFixed(1) + ") rotate(-10 72.3 485.6)");
          setKnife.setAttribute("transform",
            "translate(0," + rise.toFixed(1) + ") rotate(10 377 457.55)");
        }
        for (var i = 0; i < SLOT_X.length; i++){
          var ch = state.text.charAt(i);
          var len = slotLen(ch, i);
          [shadeSlots[i], outerSlots[i], innerSlots[i], clipSlots[i]].forEach(function(n){
            n.textContent = ch;
            if (len == null) n.removeAttribute("textLength");
            else n.setAttribute("textLength", len.toFixed(2));
          });
          shadeSlots[i].setAttribute("fill", "#D4CEC7");
          shadeSlots[i].setAttribute("stroke", "#D4CEC7");
          outerSlots[i].setAttribute("fill", state.rimOuter);
          outerSlots[i].setAttribute("stroke", state.rimOuter);
          innerSlots[i].setAttribute("fill", state.fill);
          innerSlots[i].setAttribute("stroke", state.rimInner);
        }
        paintBubbles(bubbleNodes, state);
        svg.setAttribute("aria-label", (opts.label || "Pancake timer") + ", " + state.text + ", " + state.stage);
      }
    };
  }

  /* ---- Colour interpolation ---- */
  function hex(h){
    return [parseInt(h.slice(1,3),16), parseInt(h.slice(3,5),16), parseInt(h.slice(5,7),16)];
  }
  function mix(a, b, t){
    var A = hex(a), B = hex(b);
    return "#" + [0,1,2].map(function(i){
      return Math.round(A[i] + (B[i]-A[i]) * t).toString(16).padStart(2,"0");
    }).join("");
  }
  function clamp(v){ return v < 0 ? 0 : v > 1 ? 1 : v; }
  function seg(v, lo, hi){ return clamp((v - lo) / (hi - lo)); }
  function smooth(v){ v = clamp(v); return v * v * (3 - 2 * v); }

  /* Four stops: d=0 raw / d=0.1333 (13:00) / d=1 perfect / b=1 burnt.
     The first two come from the Figma vector layers' fills and strokes;
     the last two were sampled off the exported PNGs. */
  var RAMP = {
    fill:  ["#feefcd", "#fedd94", "#d57e36", "#5e3624"],
    outer: ["#f5d59b", "#f1da93", "#fde6a9", "#cd8842"],
    inner: ["#fae3b6", "#f6d9a0", "#eb9f4d", "#e5a362"]
  };
  function ramp(stops, d, b){
    var c;
    if (d <= 0.1333) c = mix(stops[0], stops[1], seg(d, 0, 0.1333));
    else { var k = seg(d, 0.1333, 1); c = mix(stops[1], stops[2], k * k); }
    if (b > 0) c = mix(c, stops[3], Math.pow(b, 0.8));
    return c;
  }

  /* Bubbles: the batter starts bubbling, they grow, then pop and the
     surface sets; past the deadline they fuse into scorch marks. Position,
     size and colour are all functions of t, so scrubbing the timeline
     replays them correctly. */
  function paintBubbles(nodes, st){
    var d = st.d, b = st.b, t = st.t;
    var setSmooth = smooth((d - 0.78) / 0.22);   /* the surface dries out approaching 00:00 */
    for (var i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++){
      var p = BUBBLES[i], n = nodes[i];
      var up   = smooth((d - p.born) / 0.16);
      var pop  = smooth((d - p.born - 0.34) / 0.30);
      var bub  = up * (1 - pop) * (1 - setSmooth);
      var ch   = smooth((b - p.charAt) / 0.45);
      var a    = Math.max(bub * (1 - 0.8 * b), ch);
      if (a <= 0.006){ n.setAttribute("opacity", 0); continue; }

      var r   = p.r * (0.5 + 0.5 * bub) * (1 + 1.45 * ch);
      var amp = 5.5 * d;
      var cx  = p.x + Math.sin(t * 0.015 + p.ph) * amp;
      var cy  = p.y + Math.cos(t * 0.011 + p.ph * 1.7) * amp * 0.7;

      var col = mix("#f7d9a0", "#f0b757", smooth(d * 1.6));
      col = mix(col, "#a8641f", pop);
      col = mix(col, "#352723", Math.pow(b, 0.75));

      n.setAttribute("cx", cx.toFixed(2));
      n.setAttribute("cy", cy.toFixed(2));
      n.setAttribute("rx", r.toFixed(2));
      n.setAttribute("ry", (r * 0.85).toFixed(2));
      n.setAttribute("fill", col);
      n.setAttribute("opacity", (a * 0.82).toFixed(3));
    }
  }

  var STAGES = [
    {at:0.00, name:"Raw batter",  bg:"#f7ecd8", fg:"#8a6a3a"},
    {at:0.10, name:"Colouring",   bg:"#fbe4b4", fg:"#8a5c20"},
    {at:0.72, name:"Almost done", bg:"#f5c98a", fg:"#7a4415"},
    {at:0.97, name:"Perfect",     bg:"#d57e36", fg:"#fff6e6"}
  ];

  /* t is elapsed seconds; total is the length of this countdown */
  function stateAt(t, total){
    total = total || 900;
    var burn = burnOf(total), end = endOf(total);
    t = Math.max(0, Math.min(end, t));
    var d = clamp(t / total);
    var b = clamp((t - total) / burn);

    /* Display: counts down to 00:00, then counts up */
    /* ceil while counting down, so the starting value is shown for a full
       second and 00:00 appears exactly at zero. floor once counting up. */
    var secs = t <= total ? Math.ceil(total - t) : Math.floor(t - total);
    var text = mmss(secs);

    var fill = ramp(RAMP.fill, d, b);
    var rimOuter = ramp(RAMP.outer, d, b);
    var rimInner = ramp(RAMP.inner, d, b);

    var stage = STAGES[0].name, chipBg = STAGES[0].bg, chipFg = STAGES[0].fg;
    for (var i = 0; i < STAGES.length; i++){
      if (d >= STAGES[i].at){ stage = STAGES[i].name; chipBg = STAGES[i].bg; chipFg = STAGES[i].fg; }
    }
    if (b > 0){
      stage = b < 0.45 ? "Overdone" : "Burnt";
      chipBg = b < 0.45 ? "#a8663a" : "#5e3624";
      chipFg = "#ffe9d2";
    }

    return {
      t:t, d:d, b:b, text:text,
      fill:fill, rimOuter:rimOuter, rimInner:rimInner, stage:stage,
      label: t <= total ? "Left" : "Over",
      chipBg:chipBg, chipFg:chipFg,
    };
  }

  /* ---- Static stills ---- */
  var PRESETS = [
    {node:"2338:198", name:"tiimer-1", t:0,    caption:"The start of the countdown; the batter is still raw"},
    {node:"2338:209", name:"tiimer-2", t:120,  caption:"Gold starts to appear around the edges"},
    {node:"2338:228", name:"tiimer-3", t:900,  caption:"Zero, and a perfect golden brown"},
    {node:"2338:247", name:"tiimer-4", t:1080, caption:"Three minutes over, and burnt"}
  ];

  var statesHost = document.getElementById("states");
  PRESETS.forEach(function(p){
    var s = stateAt(p.t, 900);
    var wrap = document.createElement("div");
    wrap.className = "state";

    var fig = document.createElement("figure");
    fig.className = "grainy";
    var unit = makeTiimer({label:p.name});
    unit.set(s);
    fig.appendChild(unit.node);

    var h = document.createElement("h3");
    h.textContent = p.name + " · " + s.text;

    var cap = document.createElement("p");
    cap.className = "meta";
    cap.textContent = p.caption;

    var meta = document.createElement("p");
    meta.className = "meta";
    meta.textContent = "node " + p.node + " · t = " + p.t + "s";

    var sw = document.createElement("div");
    sw.className = "swatches";
    [["Fill", s.fill], ["Outer", s.rimOuter], ["Inner", s.rimInner]].forEach(function(pair){
      var el2 = document.createElement("span");
      el2.className = "sw";
      var i = document.createElement("i");
      i.style.background = pair[1];
      el2.appendChild(i);
      el2.appendChild(document.createTextNode(pair[0] + " " + pair[1]));
      sw.appendChild(el2);
    });

    wrap.append(fig, h, cap, meta, sw);
    statesHost.appendChild(wrap);
  });

  /* ---- daily#14 board, 1600x1200 ---- */
  (function(){
    var CARDS = [
      {x:99,   t:120,  action:"PAUSE"},
      {x:573,  t:900,  action:"START"},
      {x:1047, t:1080, action:"PAUSE"}
    ];

    /* Figma: base #b7630e at 90 high, mid 84, face 81; 5px #5e3624 border, 20 radius */
    function padButton(parent, x, y, w, label, size, edge, mid, face){
      parent.appendChild(el("rect", {x:x, y:y, width:w, height:90, rx:20,
                                     fill:edge, stroke:"#5e3624", "stroke-width":5}));
      parent.appendChild(el("rect", {x:x, y:y, width:w, height:84, rx:20, fill:mid}));
      parent.appendChild(el("rect", {x:x, y:y, width:w, height:81, rx:20, fill:face}));
      var t = el("text", {x:x + w / 2, y:y + 41, "class":"padlabel",
                          "font-size":size, fill:"#5e3624",
                          stroke:"#ffffff", "stroke-width":size * 0.22});
      t.textContent = label;
      parent.appendChild(t);
    }
    function cutlery(parent, cx, cy, d, vb, deg){
      cutleryAt(parent, cx, cy, d, vb, deg, 138, d === FORK_D ? "fork" : "knife");
    }

    var svg = el("svg", {viewBox:"0 0 1600 1200", width:"100%", role:"img",
                         "aria-label":"daily#14 board: three pans showing 13:00, 00:00 and 03:00"});
    svg.appendChild(el("rect", {x:0, y:0, width:1600, height:1200, fill:"#fffdf6"}));

    CARDS.forEach(function(c){
      /* Card: the 454x500 pan inside a rounded mask */
      var clipId = "c" + c.x;
      var defs = el("defs");
      var cp = el("clipPath", {id:clipId});
      cp.appendChild(el("rect", {x:0, y:0, width:454, height:500, rx:30}));
      defs.appendChild(cp);
      svg.appendChild(defs);

      var unit = makeTiimer({label:"tiimer"});
      unit.set(stateAt(c.t, 900));
      var g = el("g", {transform:"translate("+c.x+",219)", "clip-path":"url(#"+clipId+")"});
      /* the inner svg is already 454x500, so move its children straight in */
      var inner = el("svg", {x:0, y:0, width:454, height:500, viewBox:"0 0 454 500"});
      while (unit.node.firstChild) inner.appendChild(unit.node.firstChild);
      g.appendChild(inner);
      svg.appendChild(g);

      /* card border */
      svg.appendChild(el("rect", {x:c.x, y:219, width:454, height:500, rx:30,
                                  fill:"none", stroke:"#5e3624", "stroke-width":5}));

      padButton(svg, c.x, 759, 454, "SERVE", 40, "#bc8f18", "#fff4d7", "#fde6a9");
      [[323,19,2.5,3],[366,28,9,7],[79,51,2.5,1.5],[111,53,4.5,3.5],[90,65,1.5,1.5]].forEach(function(k){
        svg.appendChild(el("ellipse", {cx:c.x + k[0], cy:759 + k[1], rx:k[2], ry:k[3], fill:"#FFD565"}));
      });
      cutlery(svg, c.x + 47,  804, FORK_D,  FORK_VB,  -10);
      cutlery(svg, c.x + 407, 804, KNIFE_D, KNIFE_VB,  10);

      padButton(svg, c.x,       879, 220, "RESET",  20, "#b7630e", "#eeae6d", "#cd8842");
      padButton(svg, c.x + 234, 879, 220, c.action, 20, "#b7630e", "#eeae6d", "#cd8842");
    });

    document.getElementById("board").appendChild(svg);
  })();

  /* ---- Hero pan: animated ---- */
  /* Keep Figma's original frame: the pan is larger than the card, so the
     handle is clipped along its whole length */
  var hero = makeTiimer({label:"Pancake timer pan", dial:true});
  document.getElementById("hero").appendChild(hero.node);

  var card = document.getElementById("hero");
  var clock = document.getElementById("clock");
  var clockLabel = document.getElementById("clock-label");
  var chip = document.getElementById("chip");
  var chipText = document.getElementById("chip-text");
  var track = document.getElementById("track");
  var playhead = document.getElementById("playhead");
  var toggle = document.getElementById("toggle");
  var toggleLabel = document.getElementById("toggle-label");
  var serveBtn = document.getElementById("serve");
  var replay = document.getElementById("replay");

  var served = null;   /* verdict frozen at the moment of serving */
  var plateP = 0, plateRAF = null;

  /* The serve timeline has two segments: 0 -> 1 moves the pancake onto the
     plate, 1 -> PLATE_END lays out the cutlery. Each element eases inside
     its own segment, so this driver stays linear. */
  var PLATE_END = 1.35;      /* 1 = plating done; past 1 is the short cutlery beat */
  var SERVE_MS = 1030;       /* total time for 0 -> PLATE_END */
  function tweenPlate(to){
    if (plateRAF) cancelAnimationFrame(plateRAF);
    var reduce = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    if (reduce){ plateP = to; render(); return; }
    var from = plateP, t0 = null;
    var dur = to > from ? SERVE_MS * Math.abs(to - from) / PLATE_END : 380;
    (function step(now){
      if (t0 === null) t0 = now;
      var k = Math.min(1, (now - t0) / dur);
      plateP = from + (to - from) * k;
      render();
      if (k < 1) plateRAF = requestAnimationFrame(step); else plateRAF = null;
    })(performance.now());
  }

  var t = 0, running = true, last = null;

  function render(){
    var s = stateAt(t, DUR);
    hero.set(s, durToAngle(DUR), plateP);
    clock.textContent = s.text;
    clockLabel.textContent = s.label;
    card.classList.toggle("is-served", !!served);
    chipText.textContent = served ? served[0] : s.stage;
    chip.style.setProperty("--chip-bg", served ? served[1] : s.chipBg);
    chip.style.setProperty("--chip-fg", served ? served[2] : s.chipFg);
    serveBtn.disabled = t <= 0 || !!served;
    playhead.style.left = (t / endOf(DUR) * 100) + "%";
    track.setAttribute("aria-valuemax", Math.round(endOf(DUR)));
    track.setAttribute("aria-valuenow", Math.round(t));
    track.setAttribute("aria-valuetext", s.label + " " + s.text + "，" + s.stage);
  }

  function setRunning(on){
    running = on;
    toggleLabel.textContent = on ? "PAUSE" : "START";
    toggle.setAttribute("aria-label", on ? "Pause" : "Start");
    if (on){ last = null; requestAnimationFrame(tick); }
  }

  function tick(now){
    if (!running) return;
    if (last === null) last = now;
    t += (now - last) / 1000;
    last = now;
    var end = endOf(DUR);
    if (t >= end){ t = end; render(); setRunning(false); return; }
    render();
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }

  var grip = hero.node.grip;
  var dialHint = document.getElementById("dial-hint");
  var dialing = false;

  function pointToAngle(e){
    var r = hero.node.getBoundingClientRect();
    var vb = hero.node.viewBox.baseVal;
    var ux = vb.x + (e.clientX - r.left) / r.width * vb.width;
    var uy = vb.y + (e.clientY - r.top) / r.height * vb.height;
    var a = Math.atan2(-(ux - PCX), uy - PCY) * 180 / Math.PI;   /* 0 is straight down, clockwise is positive */
    return a < 0 ? a + 360 : a;
  }
  function dialTo(a){
    /* inside the gap, snap to whichever end is nearer rather than
       sweeping all the way round */
    if (a > DIAL_SWEEP) a = a < (DIAL_SWEEP + 360) / 2 ? DIAL_SWEEP : 0;
    setDur(angleToDur(a));
  }
  function setDur(sec){
    if (served){ served = null; plateP = 0; }
    DUR = Math.max(DIAL_MIN, Math.min(DIAL_MAX, sec));
    t = 0;
    applyDuration();
  }

  grip.addEventListener("pointerdown", function(e){
    dialing = true;
    setRunning(false);
    card.classList.add("is-setting");
    grip.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    dialTo(pointToAngle(e));
    e.preventDefault();
  });
  grip.addEventListener("pointermove", function(e){ if (dialing) dialTo(pointToAngle(e)); });
  function endDial(){ dialing = false; if (document.activeElement !== grip) card.classList.remove("is-setting"); }
  grip.addEventListener("pointerup", endDial);
  grip.addEventListener("pointercancel", endDial);
  grip.addEventListener("focus", function(){ card.classList.add("is-setting"); });
  grip.addEventListener("blur", function(){ if (!dialing) card.classList.remove("is-setting"); });
  grip.addEventListener("keydown", function(e){
    var d = null;
    if (e.key === "ArrowRight" || e.key === "ArrowUp") d = DUR + DIAL_STEP;
    if (e.key === "ArrowLeft"  || e.key === "ArrowDown") d = DUR - DIAL_STEP;
    if (e.key === "Home") d = DIAL_MIN;
    if (e.key === "End")  d = DIAL_MAX;
    if (d === null) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    setRunning(false);
    setDur(d);
  });

  /* for screen recording */
  window.__plate = function(v, verd){
    plateP = v * PLATE_END;
    served = v > 0 ? (verd || verdict(stateAt(t, DUR))) : null;
    render();
  };
  window.__dial = function(sec, showTicks){
    setRunning(false);
    card.classList.toggle("is-setting", !!showTicks);
    setDur(sec);
  };

  var legStart = document.getElementById("leg-start");
  var legEnd = document.getElementById("leg-end");
  function applyDuration(){
    legStart.textContent = mmss(DUR) + " raw batter";
    legEnd.textContent = mmss(burnOf(DUR)) + " burnt";
    grip.setAttribute("aria-valuenow", DUR);
    grip.setAttribute("aria-valuetext", mmss(DUR));
    document.querySelectorAll(".sp-btn").forEach(function(o){
      o.setAttribute("aria-pressed", Number(o.dataset.dur) === DUR ? "true" : "false");
    });
    dialHint.innerHTML = dialing || document.activeElement === grip
      ? "Counting down <b>" + mmss(DUR) + "</b> — let go to set it"
      : "Turn the pan's <b>handle</b> to set the time, or pick one";
    render();
  }
  document.querySelectorAll(".sp-btn").forEach(function(btn){
    btn.addEventListener("click", function(){
      DUR = Number(btn.dataset.dur);
      document.querySelectorAll(".sp-btn").forEach(function(o){
        o.setAttribute("aria-pressed", o === btn ? "true" : "false");
      });
      t = 0;
      applyDuration();
      setRunning(false);
    });
  });

  toggle.addEventListener("click", function(){
    if (served){ served = null; tweenPlate(0); }
    if (!running && t >= endOf(DUR)) t = 0;
    setRunning(!running);
  });
  replay.addEventListener("click", function(){ served = null; t = 0; setRunning(false); tweenPlate(0); });

  /* Serve: stop the clock and report how this pancake turned out */
  function verdict(st){
    if (st.b > 0.45) return ["Burnt\u2026", "#5e3624", "#ffe9d2"];
    if (st.b > 0)    return ["A bit overdone", "#a8663a", "#ffe9d2"];
    if (st.d > 0.92) return ["Just right!", "#d57e36", "#fff6e6"];
    if (st.d > 0.6)  return ["So close", "#f5c98a", "#7a4415"];
    return ["Not ready", "#f7ecd8", "#8a6a3a"];
  }
  serveBtn.addEventListener("click", function(){
    if (t <= 0 || served) return;
    setRunning(false);
    served = verdict(stateAt(t, DUR));
    tweenPlate(PLATE_END);
  });

  function scrubTo(clientX){
    var r = track.getBoundingClientRect();
    t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (clientX - r.left) / r.width)) * endOf(DUR);
    render();
  }
  var dragging = false;
  track.addEventListener("pointerdown", function(e){
    dragging = true; setRunning(false); track.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); scrubTo(e.clientX);
  });
  track.addEventListener("pointermove", function(e){ if (dragging) scrubTo(e.clientX); });
  track.addEventListener("pointerup", function(){ dragging = false; });
  track.addEventListener("keydown", function(e){
    var step = (e.shiftKey ? 60 : 15) * (DUR / 900);
    if (e.key === "ArrowLeft" || e.key === "ArrowDown"){ setRunning(false); t = Math.max(0, t - step); render(); e.preventDefault(); }
    if (e.key === "ArrowRight" || e.key === "ArrowUp"){ setRunning(false); t = Math.min(endOf(DUR), t + step); render(); e.preventDefault(); }
    if (e.key === "Home"){ setRunning(false); t = 0; render(); e.preventDefault(); }
    if (e.key === "End"){ setRunning(false); t = endOf(DUR); render(); e.preventDefault(); }
  });

  /* for screen recording: lets an external caller set the cook time directly */
  window.__seek = function(sec){ setRunning(false); t = sec; render(); };
  window.__icon = function(showPause){
    toggleLabel.textContent = showPause ? "PAUSE" : "START";
  };

  applyDuration();
  if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) document.fonts.ready.then(function(){ ADV = {}; render(); });
  setRunning(true);
})();
